cards.eduText: A telescope does not really magnify, it gathers light, so it shows things too faint for our eyes.

cards.imagePrompt: a single hazy orange moon with a soft golden glow around it, floating against a deep blue starry sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single bright yellow school bus, side view, parked on a grey road under a blue sky

cards.name: Bulldozer

cards.imagePrompt: a single yellow bulldozer with a wide front blade and metal tracks, side view, on brown earth under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single green tractor with very large rear wheels, side view, parked on green grass under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single yellow dump truck with its tipping body raised, side view, on brown earth under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single yellow mobile crane with a long boom raised, side view, on a grey gravel yard under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single blue bicycle, side view, standing on green grass under a blue sky

cards.name: Quad Bike

cards.imagePrompt: a single red quad bike with four fat tyres, side view, on brown dirt under a blue sky

cards.name: Go-Kart

cards.imagePrompt: a single small blue go-kart with four little wheels, side view, on a grey racetrack under a blue sky

cards.name: Taxi

cards.imagePrompt: a single yellow taxi car with a small sign on its roof, side view, parked on a grey road under a blue sky

cards.name: Combine Harvester

cards.imagePrompt: a single green combine harvester with a wide cutting header at the front, side view, in a golden wheat field under a blue sky

cards.name: Snowplough

cards.imagePrompt: a single orange snowplough truck with a wide angled blade at the front, side view, on white snowy ground under a pale blue sky

cards.name: Road Roller

cards.imagePrompt: a single yellow road roller with a wide smooth drum at the front, side view, on a grey road under a blue sky

cards.name: Forklift

cards.imagePrompt: a single orange forklift truck with two metal forks at the front, side view, on a grey concrete yard under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single blue tow truck with a lifting arm at the back, side view, on a grey road under a blue sky

cards.name: Ice Resurfacer
cards.eduText: It shaves a thin layer off the ice and lays warm water down, which freezes into a smooth new top.
cards.imagePrompt: a single blue ice resurfacing machine, side view, on a pale white ice rink in bright daylight

cards.name: Tuk-Tuk

cards.imagePrompt: a single green and yellow three-wheeled tuk-tuk, side view, parked on a grey street under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single black steam locomotive with large red wheels and a tall chimney, side view, on railway tracks under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single blue monster truck with four enormous tyres, side view, on brown dirt under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single huge tunnel boring machine with a round cutting wheel at the front, side view, on grey gravel under a blue sky

cards.imagePrompt: a single early steam locomotive with a tall thin chimney and a yellow barrel body, side view, on railway tracks under a blue sky
